name: museum-collection-care
description: Fixture profile over the museum dictionary. It exists to exercise the profile format once: pinned dictionaries, declared parameters with and without defaults, local definitions, groups that include groups, external references and an extension block. Its constraints are drawn from the parse cases.

maximum humidity.description: Mean humidity a public gallery may reach in a calendar month.

minimum availability.description: No default: a deployment must bind it or the constraint skips.

definitions: $Handling Training$ means any $course$ tagged mandatory and safety.
$Active Curator$ means any $curator$ where status is active.
$Current Loan Policy$ refers to the latest $policy document$ where status is approved ordered by effective on, version.
$Ticket Kiosk$ refers to exactly one $device$ where name is "Kiosk".

daily.title: Every day
daily.description: What must hold whenever anyone looks.

loans.title: Loans
loans.description: A statement grouping: every constraint about lending.

constraints.title: Fragile exhibits are stored
constraints.source: Every $exhibit$ tagged fragile must @be located in@ a $gallery$ tagged storage.

constraints.title: Drafts are not lent
constraints.source: No $exhibit$ tagged draft may @be lent to@ a $lender$.
Every $Active Curator$ must @have completed@ $Handling Training$ within the last year.
At least one $curator$ tagged senior must @exist@.
The $Humidity$ of $Main Gallery$ must be at most <maximum humidity> per calendar month.
The $Availability$ of $Ticket Kiosk$ must be at least <minimum availability> per calendar month.
$Current Loan Policy$ must be attested by a $Registrar$ every year.
Every $exhibit$ tagged featured must be attested by $Appraisal Service$ claiming appraisal-v2 with confidence at least 0.8 within the last #30 days#.
$Return$ must occur within #14 days# after $Due Date$.
Exactly one $policy document$ where version is <selected version> must @exist@.
